01

“given to drink from a boiling spring”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and al-Ḥasan (Q 88:5).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
given to drink from a boiling spring [al-Ghashiyah: 5], he says: “It has reached its full heat (inā), and the time for drinking it has come.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
تُسْقَى مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ [الغاشية: 5] يَقُولُ: «قَدْ بَلَغَتْ إِنَاهَا، وَحَانَ شُرْبُهَا»
Edition record 373825 · p. 724Link to report ↗
02
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 02

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: al-Mubarak ibn Fadala narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
“The Arabs used to say of a thing whose heat had reached its limit, so that nothing could be hotter than it: ‘its heat has reached its limit (anā ḥarruhu).’” So God (ﷻ) said: from a boiling spring [al-Ghashiyah: 5], saying: “God has kindled Hell against them since it was created, so its heat has reached its limit.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
«كَانَتِ الْعَرَبُ تَقُولُ لِلشَّيْءِ إِذَا انْتَهَى حَرُّهُ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ شَيْءٌ أَحَرَّ مِنْهُ، قَدْ أَنَى حَرُّهُ» ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ [الغاشية: 5] يَقُولُ: «أَوْقَدَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ جَهَنَّمَ مُنْذُ خُلِقَتْ فَأَنَى حَرُّهَا»
Edition record 373826 · p. 724Link to report ↗
03
Report from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
“The ḍarīʿ is the dry shibriq (thorny plant).”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الضَّرِيعُ: الشِّبْرِقُ الْيَابِسُ "
Edition record 373827 · p. 724Link to report ↗
02

“you will not hear therein any idle speech”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Abū Isḥāq (Q 88:11).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
you will not hear therein any idle speech [al-Ghashiyah: 11], he says: “You will not hear in it any abuse.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
لَا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً [الغاشية: 11] يَقُولُ: «لَا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا شَتْمًا»
Edition record 373828 · p. 724Link to report ↗
05
Report from Abū Isḥāq 05

Abū Isḥāq

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Isra’il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, who said:
Shurayh used to say to his companions: “Come out with us so that we may look at the camels, how they were created.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ: كَانَ شُرَيْحٌ يَقُولُ لِأَصْحَابِهِ:
«اخْرُجُوا بِنَا نَنْظُرْ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ»
Edition record 373829 · p. 724Link to report ↗
03

“you are not over them a controller”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 88:22).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
you are not over them a controller [al-Ghashiyah: 22], he says: “You are not a tyrant over them.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
لَسْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمُصَيْطِرٍ [الغاشية: 22] يَقُولُ: «لَسْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ»
Edition record 373830 · p. 725Link to report ↗
04

“except for whoever turns away and disbelieves”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 88:23).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
except for whoever turns away and disbelieves [al-Ghashiyah: 23], he says: “Then his reckoning is with God.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِلَّا مَنْ تَوَلَّى وَكَفَرَ [الغاشية: 23] يَقُولُ: «فَحِسَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ»
Edition record 373831 · p. 725Link to report ↗
